name: accumulate entropy into pools and reseed a cipher-counter generator when a pool fills
mechanism: feed unpredictable events into hash-based pools; output comes from a block cipher encrypting a counter under the current key; when a pool has collected enough estimated entropy, hash it into a new key so an attacker who learned the old state is locked out again

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Yarrow algorithm' in section Computer science / Cryptography:

requires: a block cipher and a hash
fails_when: entropy estimation is the weak point: an over-estimate reseeds too early with guessable material
